}

kb = json.loads(base_bytes)

    old = base_by_id[e['id']]
    new = became[e['id']]
    e['decision'] = new['decision']
    if 'cart_pick' in new:
        e['cart_pick'] = new['cart_pick']
    e['buying_tips'] = [old['buying_tips'][0], new['tip1'], *old['buying_tips'][1:]]
    if 'watch_add' in new:
        e['watch_out'] = [*old.get('watch_out', []), new['watch_add']]
    if 'alias_add' in new:
        e['aliases'] = [*old['aliases'], new['alias_add']]

assert review.encode() == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'f488733:docs/do-lines-review.md'])
rows = review.splitlines(keepends=True)

    if not line.startswith('| "'`'"'):
        continue
    id = line.split('"'`'"')[1]

    cells = line.split('|')

    cells[3] = ' ' + became[id]['decision'] + ' '

assert seen == set(became)

pin_path = Path('server/test/acceptance/twoLinePin.js')
pin_text = pin_path.read_text()
prefix, rest = pin_text.split('export const TWO_LINE = ', 1)
old_pin, suffix = rest.split('\\n};', 1)

'''

pin_path.write_text(pin_text)

now = json.loads(Path('server/kristy_perimeter_kb.json').read_text())
